_about: Batch B3b (Prefix caching + hybrid KV cache). Owner: the B3b writer. Reused, not redefined: prefix-caching, kv-cache-group, block-pool (core); hash-chain, cache-salt (b1b); kv-cache-block, free-block-queue, null-block, allocate-slots, block-table, kv-cache-usage (b3a).

block-hash.short: The bytes that name one full KV cache block for prefix caching: a hash of the parent block hash, the block's token ids and its extra keys. In the map it gets a 4-byte group id.

none-hash.short: The value that stands for the parent hash of block 0. vLLM derives it from a seed: PYTHONHASHSEED if set, else a fixed seed for the sha256 algorithms and a random seed for the xxhash algorithms.

extra-keys.short: Values besides the token ids that go into a block hash: the LoRA name and path, multimodal item ids, the cache salt (block 0 only) and a hash of prompt embeddings.

cache-hit-cap.short: A prefix-cache hit covers at most num_tokens - 1 tokens, because the model must compute the last prompt token to get its logits. With whole blocks, the last block is often computed again.

touch.short: BlockPool.touch(): add 1 to the ref_cnt of a prefix-cache hit block. A block with ref_cnt 0 first leaves the free block queue, so it cannot be evicted.

kv-cache-spec.short: A small dataclass that describes the KV cache of one layer: block size, page size and type (full attention, sliding window, chunked local, MLA, Mamba, ...). The type selects the single-type manager.
kv-cache-spec.long: KVCacheSpec and subclasses in {{cite vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:185-1270}}; the spec-to-manager registry ({{cite vllm/v1/core/single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:2645-2715}}).

page-size-unification.short: Making the bytes of one block equal in every layer of a model with several KV cache groups. vLLM scales up the block size of small pages, or pads pages, because all groups share one block pool.

sliding-window-manager.short: The single-type KV cache manager for sliding-window layers. It frees blocks that fall out of the window, puts the null block in their place, and searches prefix hits from right to left.

mamba-state.short: The fixed-size recurrent state of a Mamba (state-space) layer. It replaces a growing KV cache. vLLM stores it in KV blocks; prefix caching keeps states at block boundaries only in mamba_cache_mode align.

kv-events.short: Messages that an engine core publishes when its prefix cache changes: BlockStored, BlockRemoved and AllBlocksCleared. An external router can subscribe over ZMQ to know which prefixes each engine holds.
kv-events.long: Event types ({{cite vllm/distributed/kv_events.py:56-142}}); KVEventsConfig ({{cite vllm/config/kv_events.py:10-52}}); publish per step ({{cite vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py:2469-2484}}).
